notes.title: THE THIEFKING???? AND MORE GAMBLING???
notes.content:
NEW FEATURES
- NEW TRINKETS
  - Shuffle Trinket - Cannot be removed. Every level the trinket changes.
  - ??? Trinket - Extremely rare trinket that 99.9% of player’s will never get, and has a tiny chance of being given to the player randomly
- NEW PRESET LOADOUT - “A Gambling man” - Start with 3 shuffle trinkets - 37 Toll Tokens Price
- NEW NPC EVENT - NPC named ‘R. N. Garius’ who gives the player a “Shuffle Trinket”, for a fee of course.
- NEW POP UPS - Now with the ability to show player’s various controls
- THIEFKING - New variant of the thiefling, drops gold coins and a gold trinket upon death
FIXES / ADJUSTMENTS
- Added inv_desc and inv_drop to keyboard inputs, along with fixing some bugs related to keyboard layout
- Improved ‘Skins Shop’; classes are now categorized by class type, and skins show which class they are related to
- Adjusted Pot Mini Game loot
- Fixed a major bug with the CuriousFoxSox trinket
- Fixed a bug with loading and saving of overworld map footprints
- Fixed outline with StatsScreen button
- Fixed a bug where if the player canceled the slot machine then bought the vending machine, the slot machine would spin
- Fixed a bug with ‘Pristine trinket’ Text Event
- Fixed a bug related to “Lucky Trinket” and an achievement
- Fixed 2 bugs related to the vouchers
- Fixed a bug that didn’t update certain overworld aspects after text events
- Adjusted fences in two events
- Increased Health Potion cost from $100 -> $125
- Added a new tip that can be viewed in-game, related to the “Shuffle Trinket”
- Fixed ghosts in save slots showing up as red for player 2
- Fixed bug related to dying in overworld and certain trinkets
- Fixed various spelling errors
- Adjusted the ‘Wall_Fish’ sprite in desert interiors

notes.title: A GIANT BEAUTIFUL UPDATE
notes.content:
Today, we bring to you this MASSIVE update for Death's Toll. Many of these features are ones that we've been wanting since before the game's launch... So consider this the TRUE version of Death's Toll! Try it out and have fun- the game is half off right now to celebrate!

[h3]ACHIEVEMENTS[/h3]
Need some extra reason to replay the game? We've added 27 unique achievements to unlock throughout Death's Toll!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44279688/bc8c677ff3fb71f3ce44d0d79bd527dc943d0a31.png[/img]


[h3]PLAYABLE SPECIAL CHARACTERS![/h3]
Not only have we added a bunch of new special characters, but you can now play as them whenever you want! They can be purchased as skins from the character select screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44279688/6a96f250d386960f6ee9def549512e5083458ba7.png[/img]


[h3]SAVING YOUR GAME[/h3]
Sick of having to keep the game open in the background? Now you don't have to do it all in one sitting... set the game aside and take a breather, and you'll be able to load right back where you were after!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44279688/ce24759b13f616066fd5ad3d031fe542eb5022de.png[/img]


[h3]SOME NEW ITEMS[/h3]
Meet Bosh. Bosh the bush. He sells the Voodoo Doll, which creates a perfect clone of you, and the Die of Fate, which will swap your class mid-game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44279688/f6d0e5fb7adf16b1be33ea91aa8420414e7f2d56.png[/img]


[h3]GAMBLE YOUR WINNINGS AWAY[/h3]
There's a new slot machine, and it's the perfect oppertunity to take a chance for some extra money! These spawn in certain random events, and you'll also find them in every town!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44279688/504c0a390e91854ef63990dd2edf2e6464bb313e.png[/img]


[h1]OTHER HIGHLIGHTS![/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a new wolf enemy to the snow biome!
[*] There are several brand new text and map events to explore!
[*] When using a Player 2 AI, press T to whistle and call them towards you!
[*] A new Harmonica trinket which fires off music notes whenever you attack!
[*] A new Glowing Beastling Skull trinket which makes beastlings glow in the dark!
[*] A new pocket dragon you can find, and he'll turn ALL coins you find to gold... for a small fee.
[*] There are 3 new ambient music tracks that may play to help fill the silence.
[*] Some new cosmetic options have been added... check them out.
[*] The game RUNS BETTER!
[/list]

[h3]MINOR CHANGES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added shines to golden trinkets
[*] Selected Preset Loadout now saved when exiting the game
[*] Adjusted visuals of spearman jumping out of tombstone
[*] Added new Ambient Songs that can play during the game
[*] Added pop ups for the Skins Shop, Preset Loadouts, and the Class Shop
[*] Along with ‘Dead Trees’, oak stumps will now spawn in the beginning levels of the snow biome in place of pine trees (off of the same chance as the trees)
[*] Added ‘Whistle’ to call ai partners to you (Hit ‘T’ on the keyboard or ‘x’ (for xbox, other platforms use the ‘x’ equivalent) on controller, and prevents them from rushing in and attacking for ~8 seconds
[/list]

[h3]MAJOR FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed ai getting stuck in attacking animation
[*] Fixed trinkets causing stutters
[*] Fixed a bug that would consume a Trinket Voucher if purchasing a Health Potion
[*] Fixed dialogue getting stuck
[*] Fixed progress.save not saving/loading/converting properly
[/list]

[h1]MINOR FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a visual bug with picking up money and toll tokens at the same time
[*] When reaching azarel, the game will make the time at sunset if not already
[*] Fixed a visual bug when hovering over an equipped trinket
[*] Fixed a repeating line in the dance ‘competition’ text event
[*] Deer shadow adjusted
[*] Added more loot to ‘grave’ events
[*] Fixed ashen woods embers being misaligned
[*] Fixed bug with Fae-ry
[*] Fixed a visual bug with deleting classes
[*] Fixed Toll Token Glitter sprite not animating
[*] Updated ‘Defense Ambush’ Music
[*] Removed Vending Machine shadow if indoors
[*] Fixed Text Event Ui buttons sfx
[*] Protection Charm works when sleeping
[*] Special skins no longer override the player name in the Character Creator menu
[*] Fixed deer not spawning properly
[*] Fixed various bugs in the character customizer
[*] Loot is now affected by shadows
[*] Changed tip from tip man form ‘mossy graves’ to ‘tombs’
[*] Overworld hunger and thirst popping should be fixed
[*] Fixed visual bug with Character Creator
[*] Fixed a bug where player wouldn’t die if starving in overworld
[*] Reduced dance party win from 67%->33
[/list]

Thank you for your support, and have fun!

notes.title: 50% Off- UPDATE TOMORROW!
notes.content:
Hey Folks! We have some big news to share. For the next week, our game is 50% off! This is to celebrate the fact that tomorrow we will be releasing our first MAJOR content update! Filled through and through with...

SAVING/LOADING!
New trinkets
More characters (as well as a new menu to unlock them)
More levels

...and even a brand-new enemy in the SNOW BIOME!

There are even more things to see, so keep a close eye on it... and with the sale, now is the perfect time to show the game to your friends so they can see how cool you are because you play cool games.

notes.title: DEATH'S TOLL IS OUT!
notes.content:
[h2][b]After a year of hectic development, Death's Toll is finally complete![/b]

We've got a launch discount going for the next week, so you can get the game for just $6.99! You can play solo, use local co-op, or make use of Steam's remote play. If you find any issues, we have a bug report form in the top right corner of the main menu screen.

Have fun, and keep moving... The Beast is fast approaching...[/h2]
